- **Go dependency bumps:** `go-chi/chi/v5` 5.3.2 → 5.4.0, `golang.org/x/net` 0.60.0 → 0.62.0, `klauspost/compress` 1.20.0 → 1.20.2, and `golang.org/x/crypto` 0.57.0 → 0.58.1-0.20261009181718-2f1f834330b2. Go also pulled `x/sync`, `x/sys`, `x/text` and `x/tools` up a minor version as a side effect.
- **vite:** 8.3.0 → 8.3.3 in `package.json`, with `pnpm-lock.yaml` regenerated. The lockfile diff is large because vite's own `rolldown` dependency moved with it.
- **`github.com/blakesmith/ar`:** this advisory has no fixed release, so I removed the dependency. It was only used for Debian package parsing and in two test files. I added a small ar reader and writer in `modules/packages/debian/ar`. The reader rejects malformed headers, including negative member sizes (the cause of the advisory's panic). `metadata.go` and both test files now import it. Its own tests cover a round trip, a negative size, a bad global header and a truncated member.
